notes: PEER PINS ARE DOCUMENTATION-ONLY IN CODE: the four *_UPSTREAM_COMMIT constants (bounded.py:30-33) are never read. Real runtime coupling to peers is through version/profile strings (MANIFEST_VERSION, AUTHORITY_CONTEXT_VERSION/STATUS, capability and profile ids) plus duplicated logic, not through sha checks. Actual revision selection lives in the hub component-lock.json (external).

DUPLICATED PEER LOGIC: CP re-implements Manifest proposal_mismatches (bounded.py:1724-1800) and re-declares RuntimeProposal (65-95) instead of importing the manifest package, and emits the same reason-code strings. The shared code vocabulary (e.g. manifest_digest_mismatch, adapter_mismatch, target_out_of_scope) is not specified in either repo. Divergences: CP never runs validate_manifest (no invalid_manifest/unknown_tool/missing_target_policy/unbounded_target_policy codes); CP adds not_before/expires_at checks; CP amount has allow_inf_nan=False, Manifest model does not.

AUTHORITY CONTEXT HAS NO SCHEMA IN CP: it is read as raw dicts with many field paths (context.institution.*, requirement.{approvals,evidence,consequence,permissions}, grant.*, conflicts.precedence_refs). Alvorada's real schema is not vendored or referenced by sha in code; decoupling needs a vendored/versioned Authority Context schema plus conformance vectors.
interface_status='proposed_pending_governor_review' is hard-matched (bounded.py:29,1440); any Alvorada status change fails every decision.

Resolver is a Protocol (bounded.py:187-199) but destination is duck-typed with no Protocol, and apply() receives test-hook kwargs (lose_ack, partial). Executor decoupling needs a written destination interface.

LocalExecutionClaim: docs/local-authority-effect-profile.md:46 cites a 'claim schema' that does not exist in schemas/. The commitment formulas an executor must reproduce (operation_commitment payload at local_authority_effect.py:147-168; authority_state at 396-404; budget_id default 'grant:<id>' at 440; claim_commitment = commitment(raw minus claim_commitment) at 455/540-571) appear in no doc.

No format/version field on BoundedRunRecord or on RunRecord/ReplayBundle; consumers cannot detect generation except by schema shape (docs/runtime-authority-profile.md:99-103 admits old readers silently drop new fields).

Tenant generation is chosen by caller class, not a wire field: TenantRuntimeProposal vs RuntimeProposal (bounded.py:92-95, 1430). The Manifest 1.2 schema also has no generation field and keeps manifest_version const '1.1'; the label 'runtime-action-proposal/1.2' appears only in description/docstring.
Two different Alvorada commits appear: fb3d9793 (code, docs/bounded_authorization_effect.md:13, fixture) vs 9984d901 'Alvorada/GAX' (docs/workstreams/decision-input-commitment-checkpoint.md:18).
signing.py canonicalization (ensure_ascii default True) differs from bounded.commitment canonicalization (ensure_ascii=False): two canonical JSON forms in one repo.
Evidence is not tenant-bound on the default path (docs/bounded_authorization_effect.md ~'Evidence status is not tenant-bound'); relevant to any shared-resolver decoupling.
